evals.name: missing-orval-hook
evals.prompt: Backend added GET /admin/suppliers but useGetAdminSuppliers is missing from src/services/. Regenerate the client.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs make swagger, restarts the API, verifies /openapi, runs pnpm api:gen, greps for the new hook, and does not hand-edit src/services/.
assertions: Response includes make swagger on the luxe backend
Response states the API must be restarted after swagger (OpenAPI cached at startup)
Response includes pnpm api:gen from luxe-front
Response warns not to hand-edit src/services/ or orval.config.js
Response mentions verifying GET /openapi before generation

evals.name: empty-services-after-failed-gen
evals.prompt: pnpm api:gen failed while backend was down and src/services/ is mostly empty. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Agent diagnoses backend-down wipe, starts/restarts API, re-runs pnpm api:gen — does not patch generated files manually.
assertions: Response explains api:gen wipes src/services/ first
Response does not recommend hand-creating hooks in src/services/
Response includes restarting or starting the backend before re-running api:gen
